name: Cuddly Cougar 90
author: Uncannypotato69
description: Gradient rounded white button that starts animating on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, transform becomes translate(0px, 4px), box-shadow becomes 0px 0px 0px 1px #fff, 0px 0.5px 0.6px hsl(0deg 0% 73% / 0.2),
    -0.1px 1.6px 1.9px -0.7px hsl(0deg 0% 73% / 0.22),
    -0.2px 3.7px 4.4px -1.3px hsl(0deg 0% 73% / 0.25), box-shadow becomes inset 0px 8px 8px 0px #d8dad8, inset 0px -24px 24px 0px #f4f6f5.
